name: fdx
description: A Go package and command line programs for working with fdx XML files used by Screen Writing software.
releaseNotes: A tooling and command line release; the package API is unchanged. fdx2txt and txt2fdx follow the workspace conventions: exit codes 2 (bad command line, including a surplus argument, which used to be ignored), 65 (not an fdx file), 66 (missing input), 73, 74 and 77 instead of 1 for every failure; -h, -l and -v beside the long options; input and output may be given as arguments; a failed run no longer creates or empties the output file. A script that tested for exit status 1 must test for non-zero. The licence is AGPL-3.0-or-later throughout: the source headers still carried the BSD text that LICENSE replaced in v1.0.3. Every exported symbol has a documentation block. Requires fountain v1.0.4. See CHANGES.md.
